title: Squid Game Green Light
blurb: Permission to move, and a brief window before everything becomes dangerous again. The green-light cue works so well as an audio prompt because it carries no reassurance at all — it is a starting gun with a countdown hidden inside it, and everybody knows the red light is coming. Netflix's biggest show turned a schoolyard game into worldwide shorthand for high-stakes pressure. Use it to start a race, a task, a sprint of work, or any activity in which hesitation will be punished more harshly than a mistake.
origin: The Red Light, Green Light game cue from Squid Game.
